items.headline: Japan's central bank holds rates, signals caution on yen
items.body_text:
The Bank of Japan kept its short-term policy rate unchanged on Tuesday and said it would watch currency moves closely, in a decision that most economists surveyed last week had expected.

The governor told reporters that a weaker yen was raising import costs for households but that wage growth needed to be confirmed before any further tightening.

items.headline: Chilean lawmakers approve lithium royalty bill
items.description_text: Lower house passes bill raising royalties on lithium producers.
items.body_text:
Chile's lower house of Congress approved a bill on Tuesday that would raise royalties paid by lithium producers on a sliding scale linked to prices, sending it to the Senate.

Supporters said the measure would fund regional development, while mining groups warned it could deter investment in new brine projects.
